reviewed_mozzarella_links.name: Mozzarella
reviewed_mozzarella_links.review: Exact checksum GTIN, Galbani brand and fixed 125-g source package. Supplier full milk/salt/rennet/citric-acid formula is plain mozzarella; explicit consumer-level comparison quantity is drained cheese, not brine or transport weight.
